resources.string: Which map the weather radar, the Atlas and a parked car's street are drawn on.
Free, made by volunteers. Kept on this phone once seen, so a map you've opened draws again without the internet.
Google's map, with its labels and colours. Needs a Google Maps Platform API key of your own, which Google bills past the free tiles each month.
A key is saved on this phone.
Make a key in the Google Cloud console with the Map Tiles API enabled, and restrict it to that API. It stays on this phone.
No key yet: the maps stay on OpenStreetMap until there is one.
